Hymn 128: When Faith Endures
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: A. Laurence Lyon
Lyricist/Text Author: Naomi W. Randall
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 128 titled "When Faith Endures" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by A. Laurence Lyon and the lyrics were written by Naomi W. Randall.
